I was born, raised, and currently reside in the City of Roses—Portland, Oregon. I have a passion for making data meaningful, accessible, and equitable. I believe in continuously improving how we work with data. Whether that’s through better governance, building tools, or supporting making informed data driven decisions. My portfolio is a collection of data visuals, blogs, and dashboards mostly built in R.
